layout.description: 'numpad' = numeric keypad editing value.value (number). 'text'/'email'/'url' = QWERTY keyboard editing value.text (string); email/url add convenience keys (@, .com, /).

mode.description: 'inline' = the keypad is always shown. 'popover' opens it from a trigger (a later milestone; treated as inline for now).

decimals.description: Maximum decimal places. 0 = integer only (the decimal key is disabled).

enforceRange.description: Clamp the committed value to [min, max] and report output.isValid. When false, min/max are ignored.

min.description: Lower bound (used only when enforceRange is true).

max.description: Upper bound (used only when enforceRange is true).

units.description: numpad: engineering-unit suffix shown after the value (e.g. 'psi', '°C').

maxLength.description: text layouts: maximum number of characters (0 = unlimited).

showValue.description: Show the value display above the keys.

placeholder.description: popover mode: text shown on the trigger field when the value is empty.

liveUpdate.description: Write value.value on every key press (not only on Enter). onCommit still fires on Enter.

locale.description: Default UI-text language (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt), matched on the primary subtag. Empty follows the session.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale.

value.description: Two-way value. Bind `value` for the numpad layout, `text` for the text layouts.
numpad: the committed number — the source of truth. The keypad edits a local draft and writes this back on Enter (persist it from onCommit to survive a reload).

text.description: text layouts: the committed string — the source of truth. The keyboard writes this back on Enter.

value.description: The current committed value (clamped when enforceRange).

text.description: The value formatted with decimals + units.

isValid.description: numpad: within [min,max] (true when enforceRange is false). text: within maxLength.

length.description: Character length of the committed value.

draft.description: The in-progress edit string ('' when not editing).
